'''Éric Vales Ramos''' (born 18 August 2000) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)#Centre-back|centre-back]] for [[CE Casa de Portugal]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{WorldFootball.net}}</ref>

==International career==
Vales made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 16 November 2022, in a [[Exhibition game|friendly match]] against [[Austria national football team|Austria]].<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=32151 |title=Éric Vales |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=22 August 2023}}</ref>
